The '''16th Critics' Choice Awards''' were presented on January 14, 2011 at the [[Hollywood Palladium]], honoring the finest achievements of [[2010 in film|2010 filmmaking]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/general-news/social-network-snags-picture-critics-72093/ |title='Social Network' Snags Best Picture at the Critics' Choice Awards |last=Alexander |first=Bryan |date=January 14, 2011 |work=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |access-date=January 14, 2011}}</ref> The ceremony was broadcast on [[VH1]]. The nominees were announced on December 13, 2010.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/black-swan-leads-critics-choice-59107/ |title='Black Swan' Leads Critics' Choice With Record 12 Nominations |last=Alexander |first=Bryan |date=December 13, 2010 |work=[[The Hollywood Reporter]] |access-date=December 13, 2010}}</ref>
